# ARKS Integrated Engineering Consultancy LLP (ARKS IEC)

> Multidisciplinary Engineering Consultancy for Power, Civil, Infrastructure, MEPF, and Project Management.

## Overview
ARKS Integrated Engineering Consultancy LLP (ARKS IEC) is a founder-led engineering consultancy firm based in Nagercoil, Tamil Nadu, India. With over 25 years of combined senior leadership experience across international power, infrastructure, and building developments, ARKS IEC provides a single-window, end-to-end engineering platform covering Civil, Electrical (HV/LV/EHV), MEPF systems, and Project Management Consultancy (PMC).

## Core Engineering Disciplines
- **Civil & Structural Engineering**: Industrial foundation design, structural steel framing, commercial building layouts, load-bearing calculations, site planning, and civil infrastructure engineering.
- **Electrical HV / LV / EHV Engineering**: Substation design (LV, HV, EHV), grid power interconnections, transmission line structures, switchyards, relay protection and control schematics, solar integration, and smart grid systems.
- **MEPF Systems**: HVAC air distribution, fire detection and suppression, plumbing arrays, electrical building services, and computational automation.
- **Project Management Consultancy (PMC)**: Milestone PMC operations, feasibility studies, vendor bid evaluations, QA/QC audits, site management, and commissioning handover.

## Design Codes & Compliance Standards
All engineering calculations and construction documentation conform strictly to global design codes including IEC, IEEE, IS, BS, NFPA, and NBC.
